rules.text: Please keep the home quiet before 8am so our early risers can sleep.
Up to two weekend gatherings a month, under 10 people, with notice by Thursday.
We follow a rotating chore chart and clean up right after ourselves in shared spaces.
The shared kitchen is clear by 7am, and we're happy to share vegetarian staples.
Utilities and basic groceries are split equally and tracked on Splitwise; deposit is up to one month's rent.
The thermostat stays between 68 and 72°F, and the whole home is non-smoking.

open: late-night quiet hours (10pm vs 11:30pm) and friends in rooms
